int sum_of(const int *items, int count)
{
    int total = 0;
    int index;

    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        total += items[index] * 2;
    }
    return total;
}

int total_of(const int *prices, int size)
{
    int sum = 0;
    int at;

    for (at = 0; at < size; ++at) {
        sum += prices[at] * 2;
    }
    return sum;
}

int largest_of(const int *items, int count)
{
    int largest = 0;
    int index;

    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        if (items[index] > largest) {
            largest = items[index];
        }
    }
    return largest;
}

int twice(int value)
{
    return value * 2;
}
